declaredIdentity: UUIDv5 provider+subject; registration stable optional user binding; revoke retries exact replacement no-op, changed replacement conflict. OCC.
invariant: External provider+subject associates to exactly one platform user; revoked identity cannot authenticate and has one exact replacement.
boundaryRationale: Association/revocation must stay together. Provider presentation observations do not decide identity authority and can be separate observation/audit source.
identityReadingRule: selectedIdentitySummary and exact selectedCommandContracts define intended identity. baselineIdentityObservation/declaredIdentity retain older source observations only, including old replay defects; they are not target behavior or authorization to change an occupied key.

identityContractRule: Existing published owner identity/IdFor remains stable. Required typed creation/operation identity and tenant/program/source scope come from the selected signature/protocol references; no context.RequestId minting fallback or guessed new stream key.
selectedIdentityClarification: Existing UUIDv5 of identity provider + subject. Exact registration/user binding and revoke/replacement episode remain immutable; native operation terms retain that full binding.
selectedIdentitySummary: Existing UUIDv5 of identity provider + subject. Exact registration/user binding and revoke/replacement episode remain immutable; native operation terms retain that full binding.
selectedReplayRule: Current required authorization precedes replay; exact authorized retries resolve the original accepted result using the selected logical identity and immutable actor/intent/source binding. Fresh mutable feasibility, clock selection and body preparation cannot replace that original result. Expected revision is concurrency precondition, not a new identity.
commandNote: Sign-in commands (Continue*/Link*) are HTTP and write the identity inline through UserIdentityContinuation; recovery events are process-dispatched receivers. Authentication/profile events are not idempotent by CommandId.
